Aristocrat is investing in the upcoming phase of growth and market influence. This role presents an outstanding opportunity to help develop the future of Aristocrat Interactive's regulated gaming expansion. The Commercial Director Latin America & South Africa will provide focused commercial leadership for Aristocrat Interactive's growth. This role covers two key markets: Latin America and South Africa. This role is responsible for building and growing operator relationships, boosting commercial performance, supporting market entry and expansion initiatives, and ensuring strong collaboration across Product, Marketing, Legal, Compliance, Content, and Operations teams. You will manage end-to-end commercial results across the region, helping Aristocrat Interactive scale responsibly while adapting global standards to local market demands, regulatory rules, and operator priorities. Working with some of the largest operators and most respected gaming brands in Latin America and South Africa, you will develop executive relationships, shape commercial strategy, identify new growth prospects, and play a crucial part in one of Aristocrat Interactive’s most exciting regional growth stories. What You'll Do Develop and sustain strategic operator connections across regions including Latin America and South Africa. Build and complete tailored commercial strategies for each region, aligned to regional market dynamics, operator priorities, regulatory requirements, and growth targets. Foster account growth by identifying upsell, cross-sell, and fresh market opportunities throughout the region. Develop and deliver tailored strategic proposals, leading the full commercial lifecycle. Achieve revenue targets and deliver accurate forecasting and pipeline management. Conduct regular tracking, reporting, and analysis of important metrics. Lead Quarterly Business Reviews and planning sessions with customers. Collaborate with internal teams to ensure delivery against agreed benchmarks. Deliver top-tier content launch initiatives to drive market share expansion across the Latin American region and South African markets. Partner with various departments to align customer needs with our capabilities. Coordinate issue resolution and ensure seamless operational performance. Identify and coordinate customer training requirements to improve product adoption. Represent Aristocrat Interactive at key sector gatherings as a leader with a perspective. What We're Looking For Proven senior commercial leadership experience in online gaming, with direct ownership of strategy, operator relationships, and commercial growth throughout Latin America and regions in South Africa. Proven track record managing Tier-1 global operator relationships. Extensive knowledge of regulated and emerging iGaming markets, including local operator requirements, market trends, and regulatory factors. Experience in leading and developing commercial talent. Excellent collaborator management, negotiation, and presentation skills. Strong personal network of Operators and Suppliers within the iGaming industry. Proficient in spoken and written English and Spanish; Brazilian Portuguese is strongly desired. Frequent travel to connect with customers and participate in important industry events will be encouraged. Familiarity with CRM and sales tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) is desirable. Aristocrat Interactive is Aristocrat's regulated online Real Money Gaming (RMG) business and was formed in 2024 with the combination of Anaxi and NeoGames. review_candidates.description: Description Maine Medical Center Nursing Req #: 85086 This is a Clinical Nurse I vacancy open to candidates with 0 – 1 year of RN work experience This is a bargaining unit position 2 Positions Available Date posted: 10/5/2026 FT/Nights Target Start Date: 2/1/2027 Unit Bio MFT5 is a 40-bed cardiac telemetry unit seeking highly motivated RNs to join their team at Maine Medical Center. As the hospital approaches 150 years of service, it faced the challenge of remaining on its original site while addressing aging infrastructure, inefficient space, and a shortage of surgical beds. To meet the needs of Portland’s growing and aging population—particularly in cardiac care—it expanded with the Malone Family Tower, which includes 40 pre- and post-surgical beds, 19 procedure rooms, and 96 universal patient rooms. Maine's rugged coastline, with its rocky shores, dense forests, and pristine waters, served as the inspiration for this structure’s design and materials. A striking, faceted facade gives way to a soaring seven-story atrium that seamlessly links the public concourse, clinical spaces, and lounges. Analytical ability sufficient to identify changes in patients' conditions and to initiate appropriate action. review_candidates.description: En Sener deseamos incorporar en nuestro equipo a un/a Back Office Construcción y Subcontratos Electrico e Instrumentación en nuestro centro de trabajo de Madrid o Bilbao. Orientamos la ingeniería hacia la sostenibilidad de la industria y, de la sociedad. Por eso, desarrollamos proyectos orientados a lograr la máxima eficiencia en la transición hacia un modelo energético sostenible, mediante la innovación y la tecnología. Nos encargamos de la concepción, desarrollo y construcción de plantas energéticas y componentes de las mismas, abarcando desde las tecnologías más convencionales como ciclos combinados, biomasas, etc. hasta las nuevas tecnologías renovables y de futuro como offshore wind, hidrogeno verde, gestionabilidad, economía circular y sostenibilidad. Desde Home Office Dpto. Construcción y Subcontratos, Buscamos un perfil con más de 11 años en puesto similar. Darás soporte a las ofertas y a los proyectos: recursos necesarios de la especialidad, secuencias de construcción, estudios de constructibilidad, estrategia de subcontrataciones, elaboración y seguimientos de subcontratos, apoyo a proyectos en reclamaciones, planes de aceleración, etc. Entre las funciones que realizarás destacan: Elaboración de planes de constructibilidad en área E&I. Elaboración de subcontratos E&IC, tabulaciones técnicas y económicas, negociación y firma. Soporte subcontratos E&IC hasta su cierre (desviaciones, reclamaciones, gestión en caso de retrasos). Apoyo Valoraciones económicas área E&IC para Ofertas. Qué te ofrecemos: Estos son algunos de los beneficios de los que disfrutarás en Sener: Tendrás la oportunidad de participar en proyectos innovadores y de alto nivel tecnológico a nivel internacional, colaborando con un equipo multidisciplinar y altamente cualificado. Disfrutaras de una mejor gestión de tu tiempo a través de nuestras políticas de flexibilidad horaria y trabajo en remoto. Podrás optimizar tu salario con nuestro plan retributivo flexible (tarjeta de comida, seguro médico privado, tickets guardería...) y dispondrás de un seguro de vida y accidentes. Te cuidaremos con nuestro programa de bienestar físico y emocional, que incluye deportes, talleres, etc. Impulsaremos tu desarrollo profesional, con formación técnica, en habilidades, idiomas, etc. para que continúes creciendo y alcanzando tus metas. Promovemos la igualdad de oportunidades, diversidad e inclusión de todas las personas y estamos certificados como Entidad Familiarmente Responsable (efr). Si te sientes identificado/a con nuestros valores y quieres formar parte de una ingeniería familiar internacional puntera, ¡te esperamos! Queremos llegar tan lejos como quieras llegar tú.

review_candidates.title: Auxiliar administrativo de ingeniería
review_candidates.description: AUXILIAR DE INGENIERÍA Constructora Coronel se encuentra en la búsqueda de un profesional para incorporarse a nuestro equipo de trabajo Cargo: Auxiliar de Ingeniería Área: Adquisiciones, Presupuestos y Planillaje de Obra Ubicación: Guayaquil, Ecuador Modalidad: Presencial PERFIL REQUERIDO Profesional graduado en Arquitectura o Ingeniería Civil. Mínimo 3 años de experiencia verificable en el sector de la construcción. Vehículo propio y disponibilidad para movilizarse a obras, proveedores y talleres, así como para realizar viajes de trabajo. Referencias laborales verificables ( indispensable ). Perfil diligente, organizado, proactivo, responsable y con capacidad de gestión simultánea de actividades. FUNCIONES PRINCIPALES Gestionar solicitudes de materiales, insumos y servicios para los proyectos. Solicitar, comparar y analizar cotizaciones de proveedores. Elaborar cuadros comparativos y dar seguimiento a órdenes de compra. Apoyar en la elaboración de planillas de obra, cómputos métricos, presupuestos y análisis de precios unitarios (APU). Coordinar requerimientos con proveedores, talleres y residentes de obra. Realizar visitas técnicas y verificar entregas de materiales. Mantener actualizada la información técnica y administrativa de los proyectos. HERRAMIENTAS Y CONOCIMIENTOS Indispensables: InterPro: presupuestos, APU y planillaje. Excel intermedio: fórmulas, tablas y matrices de control. Familiaridad con formatos de gestión de proyectos basados en PMBOK. Conocimientos complementarios valorados: AutoCAD: lectura e interpretación de planos. Microsoft Project: seguimiento de cronogramas. ¿CÓMO POSTULAR? Envía tu hoja de vida actualizada y referencias laborales verificables a: talentoaec@gmail.com Asunto: AUXILIAR DE INGENIERÍA En Constructora Coronel trabajamos bajo tres principios fundamentales: Compromiso, Calidad e Innovación. Construyendo desde 2003. #ConstructoraCoronel #OportunidadLaboral #Guayaquil #IngenieríaCivil #Arquitectura #Construcción #EmpleoEcuador #Adquisiciones #GestiónDeProyectos

review_candidates.title: Assistant Training Officer
review_candidates.description: We’re Hiring: Assistant Training Officer 📍 Location:  Bengaluru (On-site) 🏫  Institution:  BGS College of Engineering & Technology We are looking for an  Assistant Training Officer  to support the training, career readiness, and recruitment preparation of students across our  UG and PG programmes , including  BBA, BCom, BCA, BSc, MBA, MCom, and MCA . Role Overview The Assistant Training Officer will be responsible for planning and delivering employability training, identifying student skill gaps, supporting recruitment preparation, and assisting the Training & Placement Office with company outreach and recruitment coordination. Key Responsibilities Assess training needs across UG and PG programmes and identify gaps in aptitude, communication, interview readiness, and professional skills. Plan and deliver structured employability training programmes for students across BBA, BCom, BCA, BSc, MBA, MCom, and MCA. Conduct or coordinate training in aptitude, logical reasoning, verbal ability, communication, resume writing, group discussions, and interview preparation. Organise mock interviews, workshops, career-readiness programmes, and workplace-readiness sessions. Identify students requiring additional support and provide targeted interventions. Develop training materials, assessments, practice exercises, and other learning resources. Track attendance, performance, and improvement across training programmes. Reach out to companies and build relationships with recruiters and industry professionals. Support the sourcing of internships and job opportunities across programmes. Collect job descriptions and map eligible students to suitable opportunities. Coordinate recruitment schedules, assessments, interviews, and other selection processes. Manage communication between recruiters, students, faculty, and the Training & Placement Office. Maintain training and placement records, student databases, reports, dashboards, and recruitment documentation. Coordinate with faculty, external trainers, alumni, and industry professionals for specialised training initiatives. What We’re Looking For Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills. Experience in employability training, aptitude training, campus recruitment, placement coordination, learning & development, or career services. Ability to train and engage students from different academic backgrounds. Confidence in interacting with recruiters and industry professionals. Strong planning, coordination, documentation, and follow-up skills. Proficiency in MS Office, spreadsheets, presentation tools, and online collaboration platforms. A proactive, organised, and student-centric approach to work. Qualifications Master’s degree in Management or a related discipline. Prior experience in training, campus recruitment, career services, or a Training & Placement Office will be an advantage. If you are passionate about helping students become job-ready and can combine  training, student development, industry outreach, and recruitment coordination , we would love to hear from you. 📩  Apply by sending your resume to:  nkumar1@bgscet.ac.in #Hiring #AssistantTrainingOfficer #TrainingJobs #CampusRecruitment #HigherEducation #BengaluruJobs #Employability #CareerReadiness

review_candidates.title: Assistant Manager-Mechanical-BOP
review_candidates.description: Responsibilities Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large-scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India. Adani Power Limited (APL): Adani Power Limited (APL), a part of the diversified Adani Group, is the largest private thermal power producer in India. We have a power generation capacity of 15,250 MW comprising thermal power plants in Gujarat, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, and Jharkhand, and a 40 MW solar power project in Gujarat. Job Purpose: This role is responsible for executing daily preventive and corrective maintenance tasks to ensure the optimal functioning of various BOP systems. This role will plan and document maintenance activities, manage environmental compliance, and verify financial transactions through site measurements. Additionally, this role will ensure equipment health through regular inspections, manage on-site personnel and PPE usage, and coordinate with quality departments to maintain system integrity. Key Responsibilities of Role Lead Mechanical BOP Maintenance Execution And Asset Reliability Execute daily preventive maintenance (PM) and corrective maintenance (CM) activities to ensure the reliability of DM Plant and HVAC, Fuel systems (Light Diesel Oil), Firefighting systems, CW (Cooling Water) duct systems, RO and sea intake systems. Execute maintenance activities during opportunity-based shutdowns. Execute painting, and refurbishment activities of major spares. Perform the closure of notifications and orders after work completion, ensuring all tasks are completed to the required standard. Maintenance Planning, Documentation, And Project Execution Implement seasonal maintenance plans, corrosion prevention plan and rolling plans. Execute scrap collection and disposal to the store, maintaining environmental compliance. Execute document maintenance activities meticulously for future reference and continuous improvement. Take site measurements for bill verifications to ensure accurate and fair financial transactions. Execute CAPEX projects and ensure timely completion. Create reservation slips for the issue of materials from stores and manage the return of balance spares. Equipment And Site Management Monitor the healthiness of equipment through regular field visits and inspections and report any abnormalities on the site to the Team Lead promptly. Attend to leakages in fire fighting and gas systems. Manage the day-to-day attendance of business associates, ensuring the proper use of PPEs and the healthiness of tools and tackles. Execute trials of equipment to validate performance and compliance with specifications. Coordinate with the quality department for duct coating systems. Monitor the healthiness of Sacrificial Anodes and ICCP systems for CW ducts. Business Sustainability Implement and follow IMS, AWMS, DISHA and CHETNA guidelines within the department. Maintain a strong focus on the safety of personnel and equipment through proper training and adherence to safety protocols. Conduct Tool Box Talks (TBT) to reinforce safety awareness and operational procedures among the team. Uphold 5S standards in the assigned area to promote a clean and efficient work environment. Ensure site-related safety compliances are met and followed rigorously. Follow SOPs, SMPs, and JSAs to maintain high safety and operational standards. Digitization And Automation Execute comprehensive digitization strategies to optimize operational efficiency. Implement automation solutions to support overall organizational goals/strategy. Implement process and system improvements, adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas. Key Stakeholders - Internal Chemistry Operations Fire & Safety Admin MTP Techno Commercial Key Stakeholders - External Contractors - Material & Service Qualifications Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) or Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) in Mechanical Engineering or a related field. Work Experience (Range Of Years) 4+ years of experience in industrial plant maintenance and project management. Preferred Industry Experience in the power generation, petrochemical, or heavy industrial sector.
